Goblin Underboss
Small Fey (Goblinoid), Chaotic Neutral
AC 17		Initiative +2 (12)
HP 21 (6d6)
Speed 30 ft.
	MOD	SAVE
Str	10	+0	+0
Dex	15	+2	+2
Con	10	+0	+0
Int	10	+0	+0
Wis	8	−1	−1
Cha	10	+0	+0
Skills Stealth +6
Gear Chain Shirt, Scimitar, Shortbow
Senses Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 9
Languages Common, Goblin
CR 1 (XP 200; PB +2)
Traits
Nimble Feet. The underboss can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.
Actions
Multiattack. The underboss makes two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
Reactions
Redirect Attack. When a creature the underboss can see targets it with an attack, the underboss chooses an ally within 5 feet and swaps places with it.
